title: Updated Light Blue Dye
description: This pack updates the items Light Blue Dye and Light Blue Stained Glass to match the 1.12 palette, as they were left out of the update. Fixes MC-214643.
body: This pack updates Light Blue Dye and Light Blue Stained Glass to use the more vibrant 1.12 palette as they were left behind. Fixes [MC-213641](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-214641) and [MC-214643](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-214643).
